review.assessment: The change introduces `worksched/holidays.py` with a hardcoded calendar-year holiday table and helper functions to query it. It corrects the previous off-by-one fiscal-year lookup but reintroduces an arithmetic error in `for_year(year)` that subtracts one from the requested year instead of using it directly. Consequently, any date checked against this module will be incorrectly validated against the prior year's holidays.

findings.defect: Holiday lookup retrieves wrong calendar year
